verdict.rationale: Brex's marketing documents AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments, plus bill pay as a product line. Automated GL coding by entity is also claimed, so coding and routing for payment are covered at the marketing level. Nothing in the pack shows invoice-to-purchase-order matching, which is the core of the story, and the coding and approval-routing claims are thin one-line marketing statements. missing for 10: invoice-to-PO matching, detailed docs on invoice coding and approval-routing workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
